1) Recruiter screen — 30m (Talent Ops)
2) Hiring manager technical screen (Marissa) — 45m
3) System design & runtime deep-dive (Markus + Marissa) — 90m
4) Cross-functional behavioral + PM tie-in (Laura + 1 IC) — 45m

Can you please indicate approval to: 
- Open the req in Greenhouse, and
- Approve the interview slate and interviewer list, and
- Confirm comp band is OK to proceed with offers within stated range?

Thanks — Jonas
